plan.title: bug(hooks): nested hosts get a 5s budget the framework itself calls too small, and a killed hook renders identically to an allow

narratives.Description: bug(hooks): nested hosts get a 5s budget the framework itself calls too small, and a killed hook renders identically to an allow
narratives.Origin: Prefer-A leftover-complete after product PR #5331 squash-merge; Tracking #3739.
narratives.Overview:
Product PR #5331 raised nested Claude/Grok/Codex tool.before deposit timeout from 5s to 30s and registration health rejects stale 5s deposits. SessionStart/PreCompact stay at 5s. Distinguishable timeout-vs-allow outcome for a killed nested hook remains deferred residual (not shipped in #5331).

Admitted source sentences:
1. The nested deposit budget is sized against the same measured work the Cursor budget was sized against, or the work is moved off the synchronous path so a small budget is honest.
2. A nested host that cannot complete in budget produces a distinguishable outcome — not an empty string that is indistinguishable from allow.
3. Whatever the choice, it is stated per host rather than inherited by default.
narratives.Action: Land completed xBRIEF for #3739 after #5331; defer distinguishable timeout-outcome residual.
